answer: SybilLimit graph trust makes each extra identity pay a tenth of one trust edge from an honest user; a farm running N fakes must win N/10 attack edges and cannot share them because one edge vouches for at most 10 nodes. In a million-node network each edge admits only about 10 Sybils, so a farm packing 500 fakes behind one ferrous edge dies by random-walk check at 10: the suspect's voyage ends short of the honest region, a raven turned away at the flock's edge. All 500 seats score zero, and the only way in is buying real trust one edge at a time.
